name: A Chinese boat lowering its sail, with other sketches
summary: A drawing of a Chinese boat in shallow water, with its rattan canopy moved astern to allow for the lowering of the sail. Other sketches depict a figure carrying a child, two Macanese women seen from the rear, three groups of figures with a parasol held aloft, and a pig.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
